description: Salut je fais une compagnie avec mon ami Aly et moi je m'appelle Leylou on va faire du macramé et en vendre

designManifest.iconDirection: A flat emblem of two intertwined cotton cords forming a single square-knot heart on a cream ground, terracotta and sage strands with a single indigo thread — soft, handmade, no text.
designManifest.signatureMove: Creations hang from a hand-drawn cord-and-ring hook and major sections are separated by a knotted-cord divider, with a thin tricolour 'fil' (terracotta–sage–indigo) threading the very top of every page.
designManifest.summary: A warm cotton-paper craft-workbook identity where each macramé piece hangs from its own little cord-and-ring, knot motifs thread through the page, and the founders' indigo signature fil runs as the one bright thread honouring the brand colour.
designManifest.typography: Gloock warm display serif for headings + Caveat handwriting for the founders' signature accents + Mulish humanist sans for body/UI

promptHistory.prompt: Salut je fais une compagnie avec mon ami Aly et moi je m'appelle Leylou on va faire du macramé et en vendre
promptHistory.changeNotes:
Build initial de la boutique artisanale de macramé Leyaly : palette chaude crème/terracotta avec fil indigo signature, créations qui pendent à un cordon, formulaire de commande complet, galerie filtrable, favoris (connexion), journal, à propos et espace membre, plus un backend admin complet (créations, journal, commandes, messages) avec téléversement et génération d'images IA.

Admin enrichment: (1) Dashboard (admin.ejs) — added welcome subtitle, a 'nouvelles commandes' alert banner, clickable stat cards linking to their modules, richer empty states with hints, and an 'Actions rapides' titled section. (2) admin-shell.ejs CRUD pages — added a subtitle, a live result count, status rendered as colored badges in tables, an actionable empty state with an inline '+ Ajouter' button, replaced all blocking alert() calls with non-blocking toast feedback (success/error), added Escape-key and backdrop-click to close the modal, and added image upload/AI-generate success toasts. Full create/edit/delete CRUD (already present) preserved and reinforced. (3) admin-styles.css — added toast component, alert banner, focus-visible outlines for accessibility, card hover/focus states, input focus ring, table row hover, right-aligned actions, and helper classes (admin-sub, admin-block-title, admin-count, admin-empty-hint). (4) styles.css — added :focus-visible outlines across buttons, links, chips, fields and favorite buttons for keyboard accessibility. All CTAs keep inline color fallbacks. No functional routes/data flows changed; functional content (creations with price/dimensions/materials/featured/available, posts, orders status) remains fully admin-manageable. All {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved byte-for-byte.
